test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following five-year plan addressed the issue of removal of poverty as a chief objective for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth Five-year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Fifth Five-Year Plan,** emphasizing employment,** poverty alleviation** (Garibi Hatao), and justice, also prioritized self-reliance in agricultural production and defense.
 
• However, in 1978, the newly elected Morarji Desai government rejected this plan. Notably, the Electricity Supply Act was amended in 1975, granting the central government authority in power generation and transmission.
 
• During this period, the Indian national highway system was introduced, leading to the widening of many roads to accommodate increasing traffic. Additionally, tourism experienced significant growth.
 
• The twenty-point program, launched in 1975 and implemented from 1975 to 1979, aimed at addressing various socio-economic challenges.
 
• A significant initiative during this period was the Minimum Needs Programme (MNP), introduced in the first year of the **Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–78)**. Spearheaded by D.P. Dhar, its objective was to fulfill basic minimum needs and enhance living standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Fourth Five-Year Plan,** implemented from 1969 to 1974, marked the initiation of Indira Gandhi's government and was formulated to address various challenges.
 
• **The Third Five-Year Plan in India,** operational from 1961 to 1966, was centered on fostering economic development.
 
• **The Sixth Five-Year Plan in India,** executed from 1980 to 1985, aimed to achieve rapid industrialization, enhanced employment opportunities, poverty alleviation, and technological self-sufficiency as its primary objectives.
